purpose: Close ASVS V14.2.4 at its cause: give the platform one sensitive-data classification, so the channel that leaves the platform can no longer be protected more weakly than the internal logs.
requiredInvariants: Coverage only widens; no class is dropped from the internal classification to make the sinks agree.
One module declares the classification and both sinks consume it.
Field names are matched exactly after normalization, never by substring, so coverage is not overstated.
Events stay useful: non-sensitive fields and the user id survive redaction.
Personal data is not collected by SDK default.
Tests derive their cases from the classification, so a new class is enforced outbound automatically.
A decision whose evidence this change invalidates is rewritten in the same PR.
No new dependency and no cryptography.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database change.
acceptance: Every name in the shared classification is redacted in body, headers, extra, contexts, tags, breadcrumb data and query string, asserted by iterating the list itself.
Every value rule has a sample and the suite fails if a rule ships without one.
Authorization, Set-Cookie and cookies never leave, while ordinary headers survive.
The outbound scrubber and the internal masker produce identical output for the same payload.
Dropping a surface from the scrubber was verified to turn the suite red.
V14.2.4 moves FAIL to PASS with conditions that watch both sinks and the parity test.
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions at the head.
